newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT-HK Telecom rated "reduce".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-HK Telecom rated "reduce".

text.p: Merrill Lynch has lowered its near-term recommendation on Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd to "reduce" from "neutral" despite China Everbright Holding Co Ltd's purchase of 7.74 percent of the utility last week.

"At current levels, we feel that the risk-reward equation has moved too far and that investors should take advantage of the appreciation to reduce holdings," Merrill Lynch said in a report dated May 12.
Merrill Lynch said it suspected China Everbright's purchase of the shares might have been driven by "higher level considerations, principally 'face'."
The run in Hongkong Telecom's share price on hopes of a China deal had gone too far, said Merrill Lynch, questioning the utility's fundamentals.
"If the underlying fundamentals of the company are weak, ultimately so we believe will the post-deal (with a mainland company) share price," Merrill Lynch said.

While the China Everbright acquisition could presage a larger stake to be bought from Hongkong Telecom's parent, potentially strengthening the utility's mainland ties, the competitive outlook in Hong Kong was a "drag on futures earnings growth", it said.
Hongkong Telecom's major shareholder is Cable and Wireless Plc, which holds just over 59 percent of the utility.

Hongkong Telecom's shares were at a 13 percent premium to the Hang Seng Index 1997 estimated price/earnings ratio even though the utility's earnings per share growth prospects were expected to lag the market, Merrill Lynch said.

Hongkong Telecom relied an international telephony market which is "fundamentally flawed (in terms of price versus costs relationships)" for 53 percent of its revenues, a high level of exposure, Merrill Lynch said.
It said China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications had also made it clear it opposes direct equity involvement in China's market by foreign telecoms.
CITIC Pacific Ltd announced on May 9 it would sell 7.74 percent of Hongkong Telecom to China Everbright, a holding company controlled by China's State Council.
China Everbright has three listed subsidiaries in Hong Kong -- China Everbright International Ltd, China Everbright Technology Ltd and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd.
Hongkong Telecom shares were up HK$0.10 at HK$15.60 on Friday morning.
